fullDescription: A high-precision, light-mode diagnostic dashboard designed for industrial monitoring and IoT diagnostics. It features a clean 'glass-card' aesthetic with heavy emphasis on high-contrast typography, specifically 'Satoshi' Black. The color palette centers on a clinical white and slate base with emerald green for operational status, utilizing wide-tracked uppercase labels for a technical feel. Layout is a structured 12-column grid with generous spacing, subtle entrance animations, and data-dense components like progress rings and sensor grids. Ideal for fintech analytics, machine health monitoring, and scientific data visualization.
prompt:
## Resumo
A sophisticated light-themed industrial diagnostic dashboard using a 12-column layout. The design features oversized status indicators, high-density sensor grids, and animated confidence meters. It employs a 'Satoshi' font stack with weights ranging from Regular to Black, emphasizing data hierarchy through size and letter-spacing.

## Estilo Visual
Apply a high-tech light-mode style. Background: radial-gradient at 50% 50% from #F8FAFC to #FFFFFF. Primary Typography: 'Satoshi' for all text; use 900 (Black) for status values (e.g., 60px size) and 400 for body. Subheaders/Labels: 10px-12px size, font-weight 700, text-transform uppercase, letter-spacing 0.15em, color #94A3B8. Component Style: 'glass-card' with 32px (2rem) border-radius, background #FFFFFF, border 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.06), box-shadow 0 4px 20px -2px rgba(0,0,0,0.04). Hover effect: transform translateY(-4px) scale(1.005), border-color rgba(0,0,0,0.1), shadow 0 12px 30px -5px rgba(0,0,0,0.08). Animation: Entrance via fade-slide-up (opacity 0 to 1, translate 30px to 0) using cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1) over 0.8s. Accent: Emerald #10B981 with a pulse animation (box-shadow expanding to 10px with 0 opacity).

## Layout e Estrutura

### Overall Container
Max-width 1440px centered container with padding 24px (mobile) to 64px (desktop). Main layout is a 12-column grid with a 32px (2rem) gap between columns.

### Left Column - Primary Status
Occupies 4 columns. Contains two vertically stacked cards. Top card: Hero Status with a center-aligned 12px pulsing emerald dot, a 12px uppercase label, and a massive 60px 'Satoshi' Black title. Bottom card: Model Confidence featuring a 192px (48rem) circular SVG progress ring (stroke-width 8, stroke-linecap round) with the percentage value centered in 'Satoshi' Black 36px font.

### Center Column - Narrative Data
Occupies 4 columns. Top card: High-density narrative summary with sections separated by 1px border-slate-100 dividers. Includes blue and purple 16px Lucide-style icons. Bottom card: Recommendation alert with a light emerald background (#F0FDF4), featuring a 24px check-circle icon and a 20px bold recommendation title.

### Right Column - Technical Details
Occupies 4 columns. Includes: 1. Failure Analysis card with 'Decision Path' breadcrumbs (small chips with 1px borders and chevron-right icons). 2. Sensor Data grid (2x2) with cards using #F8FAFC background and 16px border-radius. 3. Model Breakdown featuring thin 6px progress bars with distinct colors (Blue #3B82F6, Purple #A855F7, Emerald #10B981) and 10px uppercase tracking labels.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Decision Path Breadcrumbs — Sequential logic flow chips for AI/Diagnostic transparency.
Create a row of chips with 8px border-radius, background #F8FAFC, border 1px solid #E2E8F0. Padding: 4px 12px. Text: 10px font-weight 700, color #64748B, uppercase. Separate with 12px Lucide chevron icons colored #CBD5E1.

### Animated Progress Ring — Visual confidence meter with stroke animation.
SVG-based circle with 80px radius. Background circle stroke: #F1F5F9. Foreground circle stroke: #10B981 with stroke-dasharray and stroke-dashoffset transition (1.5s ease-in-out). Centered text should use Satoshi Black for the number and Satoshi Regular for the percentage symbol.

## Notas Especiais
MUST: Maintain a strict 2rem (32px) border-radius on all main cards for a 'soft-industrial' look. MUST: Use 'Satoshi' Black (900 weight) for any numerical data or primary status words. MUST NOT: Use heavy borders; keep them at 1px with very low opacity (0.06 - 0.1). MUST: Implement staggered entrance animations (0.1s increments) for each card to create a premium load experience.

Colors: Pure White (#FFFFFF) background with Slate (#F8FAFC) gradients, Emerald (#10B981) for success, and Slate-900 (#0F172A) for primary text. Animation includes 0.8s cubic-bezier entrance transitions and pulse effects on status dots.
